prefix_messages.content:
Translate the question into a single read-only Neo4j Cypher query.
Return only the query, with no explanation. Use the supplied complete graph schema.
Return entity names/properties, not node or path objects. Do not add a default
LIMIT; use a limit only if the question asks for one. Preserve requested DISTINCT,
time filters, grouping and ordering. Database-side aggregation is allowed.
Node metadata: eid,name,aliases,description; relationship metadata: rid.
No write/admin/procedure statements. Read subqueries CALL { ... } are allowed.

prefix_messages.content:
The engine is pinned native TuGraph 4.5.2, not Neo4j.
Only actual schema properties exist; entity identity is identity_property.
Do not assume eid, rid, aliases, name or description unless actually declared.
Use actual simple schema identifiers; quoted label spelling was not equivalent
in independent checks. Use explicit variable lists in WITH, not WITH *.
Separate consecutive MATCH/OPTIONAL stages using explicit WITH bindings.
Global post-OPTIONAL predicates require a subsequent explicit WITH stage;
carry needed nodes and scalar edge properties, avoiding unused nullable edges.
Preserve relationship-bag multiplicity, NULLs and zero-neighbor groups.
For three-valued WHERE negation, guard compared operands IS NOT NULL before NOT.
When counting entities, count the actual declared non-null primary property;
do not use a node-object COUNT DISTINCT that can bypass an expansion here.
Native datetime literals use a space separator and up to six fractional digits.
Do not guess timezones or silently drop precision. BOOL values are true/false.
No writes/admin/procedures. Return only requested scalar/list/map properties,
not node/relationship/path objects. No default LIMIT; preserve requested order.

Translate the question into one read-only native Cypher query.
Return only the query without Markdown or explanation. Use the complete schema,
common entity suggestions and native-engine notes. General read query constructs
supported by the engine are permitted; you are not restricted to the service IR.
Keep the requested predicates, multiplicities, distinctness, grouping and order.
If the engine cannot express the request, do not replace it with an easier task.

prefix_messages.content: Translate the public question to one read-only Neo4j Cypher query. Return the query only. Use the exact supplied native schema and requested result semantics. Do not invent properties, synthetic eid/rid fields or default LIMITs. Preserve DISTINCT, grouping, order, NULL and multiplicity. Database-side aggregation and read-only CALL { ... } subqueries are allowed. Writes, admin commands, procedure calls and database switches are not allowed.

prefix_messages.content: Return one JSON object only. Both methods use status ANSWER, UNSUPPORTED or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. A decline has only status and a nonempty reason. Declines are not correct numeric answers. Never invent missing history, people identity or employment facts. Use the common input only; a valid executed answer receives no gold-driven repair. For ANSWER use {"status":"ANSWER","query":"one read-only Neo4j 5.15 Cypher"}. No parameters outside the query, explanations or extra fields. Native read patterns, aggregates, UNION and read subqueries remain available. No write/admin/procedure/database-switch commands. Use declared data and explicit absolute-instant conversions; no implicit LIMIT.
